title: Harry Potter Fans Applaud Tom Felton's Malfoy Return - NewsBreak
text:
By Sibanee Gogoi ,
1 hours ago Photo by Bruce Glikas/WireImage/Getty Image Harry Potter fans are over the moon, ecstatic about Tom Felton ‘s Broadway debut as beloved Draco Malfoy . Felton’s much-awaited return to the Wizarding World has sparked a social media storm. Seeing Felton as the iconic Draco Malfoy on stage is a dream come true for many, and the audience surely made it evident by welcoming him with cheer and applause.
Harry Potter’s Tom Felton makes Draco Malfoy return on Broadway Fans went wild with excitement as Felton made his first-ever appearance on Broadway. The audience got all nostalgic upon witnessing Felton in his beloved character during the Harry Potter and the Cursed Child show. Moreover, Felton, being the incredible actor he is, kept the audience hooked with his enthralling performance throughout the act.
Felton’s Broadway performance is already getting rave reviews. Fans can’t stop gushing about his portrayal as Draco, who is now a father. Draco’s becoming a father has added a new depth to the complex character.
The official @cursedchildus Instagram account posted Felton’s Broadway debut, garnering massive reactions from Potterheads across the globe. The caption of the pinned post says, “It’s true then, what they’re saying on the train. Tom Felton has come to Broadway. Tom Felton makes his first appearance as Draco Malfoy on Broadway.”
The post features Felton appearing on the stage as Malfoy, and as expected, the audience starts screaming in excitement. The comment section filled up in no time with fans leaving praises and hype comments for their favorite villain.
“He stayed in character so well, but Tom was definitely grinning on the inside”, one fan commented. “THE SCREAM I JUST LET OUT LIKE I WAS IN THE CROWD,” another chimed in. “He was trying so hard not to react to all the love,” one fan wrote. “Well-deserved cheers for THE ONE & ONLY Draco Malfoy,” yet another fan comment read.
After the final applause, Felton bows to the audience, a gesture that showcases his connection to the loving franchise.
He also had tears in his eyes as he made his way off the stage.
